text_en: The ark of the Lord was in the country of the Philistines seven months.
text_cn: 上主的约柜在培肋舍特地方七个月之久。

text_en: Then the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the Lord ? Tell us what we should send with it to its place. ”
text_cn: 培肋舍特人召集司祭和占卜者说：“我们对上主的约柜该作什么？请告诉我们，用什么方法可将它送回原处？”

text_en: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it empty, but by all means return him a guilt offering. Then you will be healed and will be ransomed; will not his hand then turn from you? ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“你们若将以色列天主的约柜送回，不可空空的将它送回，必须奉上赎罪的礼品：这样你们才能痊愈，也会明了他的手为什么没有离开你们。”

text_en: And they said, “What is the guilt offering that we shall return to him? ” They answered, “Five gold tumors and five gold mice, according to the number of the lords of the Philistines; for the same plague was upon all of you and upon your lords.
text_cn: 他们问说：“我们应奉上什么赎罪的礼品？”他们回答说：“按照培肋舍特酋长的数目，奉上五个金毒疮像和五个金鼠像，因为你们所有的人和你们的酋长，都遭遇同样的灾祸。”

text_en: So you must make images of your tumors and images of your mice that ravage the land, and give glory to the God of Israel; perhaps he will lighten his hand on you and your gods and your land.
text_cn: 所以你们应制造你们患的毒疮像，和损坏你们地方的老鼠的像，应归光荣于以色列的天主：这样或许他会对你们，对你们的神和你们的地方放松他的手。

text_en: Why should you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? After he had made fools of them, did they not let the people go, and they departed?
text_cn: 你们为什么像埃及人和法郎一样心硬呢？不是上主玩弄了他们以后，埃及人才放走了他们吗？

text_en: Now then, get ready a new cart and two milch cows that have never borne a yoke, and yoke the cows to the cart, but take their calves home, away from them.
text_cn: 现今，赶快制造一辆新车，牵出两头正在哺乳，还没有负过轭（è）的母牛来，套上这辆新车，把小牛牵回棚里去；

text_en: Take the ark of the Lord and place it on the cart, and put in a box at its side the figures of gold, which you are returning to him as a guilt offering. Then send it off, and let it go its way.
text_cn: 然后把上主的约柜装在车上，把那奉上作为赎罪礼品的金器，都盛在一匣子内，放在约柜旁边，然后让它去。

text_en: And watch; if it goes up on the way to its own land, to Beth-shemesh, then it is he who has done us this great harm; but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us; it happened to us by chance. ”
text_cn: 但你们应留神：若是约柜取道往自己的地方去，即往贝特舍默士去，那么，这大灾难，即是上主加给我们的；若不然，我们就知道，不是他的手打击了我们，而我们所遭遇的是出于偶然。”

text_en: The men did so; they took two milch cows and yoked them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.
text_cn: 人们就这样作了；牵出两头正在哺乳的母牛来，套上那辆新车，将牛犊关在棚里，

text_en: They put the ark of the Lord on the cart, and the box with the gold mice and the images of their tumors.
text_cn: 把上主的约柜，以及装有金老鼠和毒疮像的匣子，都放在车上。

text_en: The cows went straight in the direction of Beth-shemesh along one highway, lowing as they went; they turned neither to the right nor to the left, and the lords of the Philistines went after them as far as the border of Beth-shemesh.
text_cn: 那对母牛直直奔向贝特舍默士的路上走去，一边走，一边叫，不偏左也不偏右；培肋舍特的酋长跟在后面，一直到了贝特舍默士的边境。

text_en: Now the people of Beth-shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley. When they looked up and saw the ark, they went with rejoicing to meet it.
text_cn: 那时，贝特舍默士人正在谷中收割麦子，举目一看，见是上主的约柜，就前去欢迎。

text_en: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh, and stopped there. A large stone was there; so they split up the wood of the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 车来到贝特舍默士人约叔亚的庄田，就在那里停住了。那里有一块大石头，人就将车辆的木头劈开，把母牛祭献给上主作全燔祭。

text_en: The Levites took down the ark of the Lord and the box that was beside it, in which were the gold objects, and set them upon the large stone. Then the people of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings and presented sacrifices on that day to the Lord .
text_cn: 肋未人先把上主的约柜和旁边盛有金器的匣子搬下来，放在那块大石上。贝特舍默士人当天给上主献了全燔祭，宰杀了许多牺牲。

text_en: When the five lords of the Philistines saw it, they returned that day to Ekron.
text_cn: 培肋舍特的五位酋长见事已成，当天就回了厄刻龙。

text_en: These are the gold tumors, which the Philistines returned as a guilt offering to the Lord : one for Ashdod, one for Gaza, one for Ashkelon, one for Gath, one for Ekron;
text_cn: 以下是培肋舍特人奉献给上主作为赎罪礼品的金毒疮像：阿市多得一个，迦萨一个，阿市刻隆一个，加特一个，厄刻龙一个。

text_en: also the gold mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both fortified cities and unwalled villages. The great stone, beside which they set down the ark of the Lord , is a witness to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.
text_cn: 金老鼠也是依照培肋舍特五酋长的城市数目，包括有垣墙的城市和所有的村落。那曾安放过上主约柜的大石，直到今日还在贝特舍默士人约叔亚的田内，作为见证。

text_en: The descendants of Jeconiah did not rejoice with the people of Beth-shemesh when they greeted the ark of the Lord ; and he killed seventy men of them. The people mourned because the Lord had made a great slaughter among the people.
text_cn: 当贝特舍默士人看见上主的约柜时，耶苛尼雅的子孙没有与他们一起表示欢乐，所以上主击杀了他们中七十人。百姓就难受，因为上主这样严厉打击了百姓。

text_en: Then the people of Beth-shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before the Lord , this holy God? To whom shall he go so that we may be rid of him? ”
text_cn: 于是贝特舍默士人说：“在这神圣的天主上主面前，谁还能站得住？从我们这里把它送到谁那里去呢？”

text_en: So they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim, saying, “The Philistines have returned the ark of the Lord . Come down and take it up to you. ”
text_cn: 他们遂派使者到克黎雅特耶阿陵的居民那里，对他们说：“培肋舍特人送回了上主的约柜，你们下来，将它抬上去，放在你们那里。”
